user.title: Database Cleaner
user.description: Adds an admin-only sidebar panel to analyse the recorder database, find statistics nobody uses, back the database up and delete selected long-term statistics safely, plus sensors with the chattiest entities.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Database Cleaner is already set up.
abort.unsupported_db: Only the SQLite recorder database is supported.

data.cache_hours: Cache for the long-term statistics scan (hours)
data.backup_max_age_hours: A backup counts as fresh for (hours)
data.backlog_limit: Wait while the recorder queue is above

data_description.state_windows: Limited by recorder purge_keep_days: older states are not in the database.
data_description.cache_hours: The full statistics scan reads the whole table; it is repeated at most this often unless you press Refresh.
data_description.backup_dir: Default: /share/database_cleaner/backups on Home Assistant OS, otherwise <config>/database_cleaner/backups. Undo archives go to the undo subfolder.
data_description.backup_max_age_hours: Delete and repack jobs make a new verified backup unless one is younger than this.
